# Pepper

> A build log documenting the development of an AI assistant named Pepper.
> Author: Danny Kim
> Language: Korean (primary), English
> Topics: AI development, solo developer, personal AI assistant, build log
> Episodes: EP 00 – EP 19
> Site: https://pepper.kimsheritage.com

## About

Pepper is a build log — a serialised account of building an AI assistant that feels less like a tool and more like a person. The name references Pepper Potts, not Jarvis: the goal is context-awareness, human-adjacent support, and genuine usefulness without coldness.

## Episodes

- EP 00: Why I Named It Pepper — The origin story and name choice.
- EP 01: The Problem With Jarvis — Why the Jarvis archetype fails in practice.
- EP 02–19: Coming soon.

## Author

Danny Kim, Managing Director at Kims Heritage Holdings. Solo developer building Pepper.
